### 4. Scored parameters

**(a) No-show charge.** Baseline ("Room Reservations No-Show Charge: Amount and Settlement Limit"): B&B no-show basis first night room and tax, tax added (Penalty Basis Tariff) → 832.00 × 1.10 = 915.20; capped last at the money held (1,830.40, not binding).
Factors reached from records:
- "Room Reservations No-Show Night and Services Never Provided" — plan is the Bed & Breakfast Package Rate (package) → no-show night 832.00 − 32.00 = 800.00.
- "Direct-Booking Courtesy on … No-Show Charges" — `brand_website` + active membership → 3%.
- "Ashbury Rewards Elite Courtesy on … No-Show Charges" — Silver Elite, 18 ≥10 → 10%.
- "Stay-History Courtesy on … No-Show Charges" — postings in the twelve months before 2026-11-27; 2025-11-27 is "on … the same calendar date twelve months earlier" → outside; 5 stays → 5%.
Assembly: 800.00 × 1.10 × 0.97 × 0.90 × 0.95 = 729.828 → **729.83**; ≤ 1,830.40. Basis `first_night_room_and_tax`, settlement `advance_deposit`.
Fall-back: 915.20.

**(b) Refund of money held.** Baseline ("Refund Amount on Room Reservations Money Held After a No-Show"): money held 1,830.40 − amount kept 729.83 = 1,100.57, never below zero, rounded once.
Factors:
- "Deposit Handling Fee on Long-Held Resort Deposits" — brand Ashbury Reserve, booked 2026-08-10 → refund day 2026-11-27 = 109 days ≥100 → 45.00.
- "Ashbury Rewards Elite Waiver of … Deposit Handling Fees" — Silver 18 ≥10 → 25% waived.
- "Direct-Booking Waiver of Deposit Handling Fees" — direct + active → 40% waived.
- "Room Reservations Deposit Handling Fee Limits by Refund Size" — amount tested 1,100.57 ≥ 1,000.00 → "the lesser of the handling fee and the large-refund fee cap of 20.00".
Assembly (my reading): waivers first, then the size limit as the step that yields "the fee charged": 45.00 × 0.75 × 0.60 = 20.25 → lesser of 20.25 and 20.00 = 20.00; refund = 1,100.57 − 20.00 = **1,080.57**, naming the most recent deposit payment `0e544c05-…`.
**Ordering not closed by the visible text**: the waivers act on "the fee as it stands at that point, before the fee is taken off the refund"; the limit doc says "the fee charged is the lesser of the handling fee and … 20.00" and "any other refund is charged the handling fee as it stands", and its cases use raw schedule fees (25.00/45.00) as "Handling fee". Neither document pins whether the size limit acts before or after the waivers. Cap first gives 20.00 × 0.75 × 0.60 = 9.00 → refund 1,091.57. Both readings are reasonable on the visible surface; I chose 1,080.57 because the limit doc presents its output as "the fee charged" that "reach[es] the cent … on the refund", i.e. the last step before subtraction, but the alternative is not excluded by any visible sentence.
Fall-back (computation document only, on the fall-back no-show charge): 1,830.40 − 915.20 = 915.20; on the derived charge: 1,100.57. Both differ from 1,080.57.
Observation: the refund hub's rule sentence itself says the hotel "refunds the rest of the money held less the deposit handling fee", so the existence of a handling fee is announced in the hub rather than discovered only from the records (the computation document itself is silent). Carried to dependency_form for judgement against the source.
